title: Cross-chapter paging feels like a hard cut instead of a continuous page turn
symptom: Page turns inside a chapter felt smooth, but crossing from one chapter to the next or previous chapter produced a visibly different hard switch.
root_cause: Intra-chapter turns used the pager's normal horizontal animation, while cross-chapter turns rebuilt chapter content and pager state without any boundary transition layer.
fix: Added boundary transition layers that move in the same horizontal direction as normal page turns.
Applied the same page padding model to boundary layers so chapter-edge turns keep the same page silhouette as normal turns.
impact: Readers could feel the implementation seam exactly at chapter boundaries, which weakens page-mode immersion.
